result.summary: No clearly broken layout or functionality is visible; the main concern is minor readability of small muted secondary text. Horizontally clipped carousel items and bottom viewport truncation were excluded as requested.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees, time ranges, and category labels is small and low-contrast gray, which may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size slightly and/or darken the gray to meet WCAG contrast guidance while preserving the visual hierarchy.
